notes: Read-only UI-layout audit of all 44 built tools, backing the user's request to fix duplicated grid layouts, uneven right-column panel heights, and control-button position (currently below .media-preview on almost every camera/audio tool; should be above). Root causes: (1) .media-controls{margin-top:1rem} in styles.css assumes controls follow .media-preview in the HTML source -- true on 25/44 tools; only webcam-side-by-side-comparison already has controls first. (2) .tool-grid{align-items:start} plus .tool-panel.primary{grid-row:span 2} means the two secondary/tertiary panels' combined height rarely matches the primary hero panel's height when they're short (a 4-tile stat-grid + 1-line diagnostic-panel is much shorter than a 16:9 video + controls + action row), leaving visible empty space. (3) ~10 tools share a near-verbatim 'hero-preview + 4-tile stat-grid + one generic diagnostic-item (Click Start Camera/Microphone and allow access...)' skeleton with no tool-specific secondary content -- these are the real 'low effort' duplicates. Most other tools already have genuinely distinct secondary panels (real data tables, comparison lists, dynamic advice, download-a-reference-chart features) and only need the controls-position fix.

fix_progress.css_root_cause_fix: styles.css .tool-grid changed align-items:start -> align-items:stretch. This is the primary fix for the 'right column height mismatch' complaint: side panels now stretch to fill the primary hero panel's full row height (matching card bottom edges) instead of sitting at the top of their cell with visible empty space below. Applies automatically to all 44 tool pages, no per-tool markup change needed for this part.

controls_reordered_to_top.note: Moved each tool's .media-controls block to appear before its .media-preview/.dual-preview/canvas visual element, and flipped the CSS spacing rule (.media-controls margin-top:1rem -> margin-bottom:1rem) so buttons now sit above the tool area instead of below, per explicit user request.
controls_reordered_to_top.not_applicable: left-right-stereo-channel-test, speaker-test-online, microphone-record-playback-test, and microphone-echo-test already had controls at/near the top of their panel (no video/canvas hero to be 'below'); camera-permissions-guide-windows-mac-android-ios, webcam-resolution-standards-reference, and webcam-specs-comparison-database use .media-controls purely as a filter/tab-bar styling class unrelated to camera/mic Start/Stop controls, so the reorder doesn't apply to them.
